newsitem.title: USA: SPS Technologies acquires Greer Stop Nut.
newsitem.headline: SPS Technologies acquires Greer Stop Nut.

text.p: SPS Technologies Inc said Monday it has purchased Greer Stop Nut Inc of Nashville, Tenn., for $10 million. Gen Cap America Inc acted as an advisor to Greer in completing the transaction.

Greer is a manufacturer of nylon insert prevailing torque nuts -- "locking" nuts. Sales for the year ended December 31, were $13.1 million. Greer's products are sold to customers in general industrial, automotive, aerospace and defense markets.
The acquisition of Greer adds a complementary branded product line to SPS's Unbrako business.
